item.title: Acclaimed Sydney chef Mitch Orr bringing two-day Bar Canopy takeover to Adelaide
item.description: Acclaimed Sydney chef Mitch Orr will take over Bar Canopy for two exclusive days during Tasting Australia 2026, with intimate lunches and relaxed evening snack sessions.

item.title: Vietnamese Tet Festival welcomes the Year of the Fire Horse with jam-packed weekend of fun and festivities
item.description: The Vietnamese Tet Festival returns to Adelaide during Lunar New Year for two afternoons of entertainment and celebrations.

item.title: Victor Harbor Fringe Festival brings markets, music and psychic fun to the Foreshore
item.description: The Victor Harbor Fringe Festival will transform Warland Reserve into a family-friendly celebration of markets, music, food and community vibes this Valentine’s Day weekend.

item.title: Win a trip to Prague with The Garden of Unearthly Delights’ once-in-a-lifetime Fringe giveaway
item.description: The Garden of Unearthly Delights is giving Fringe lovers the chance to win a dream trip for two to the Prague Fringe Festival in 2026, simply by buying tickets to a Garden show.

item.title: Tasting Australia drops its full program, with punk fine dining, open-flame feasts, quiz nights and more
item.description: Tasting Australia presented by Journey Beyond has unveiled its 2026 program, featuring boundary-pushing dining experiences, international culinary stars and immersive events across Adelaide and the regions.

item.title: De La Soul to headline SA brewery birthday party with epic line up
item.description: A popular SA brewery is set to host epic party for their eleventh birthday, with a huge selection of limited-release beers and a hot lineup of performers.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: A new creative hub is bringing natural wine, photography, design and “absolutely no matcha” to Adelaide
item.description: A Gilbert Street warehouse has been reimagined as a multi-use creative hub, blending mid-century furniture, artisan baking and contemporary photography under one roof.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Under the Sun Wine Collective brings cellar door, beer garden, and late-night wine bar energy to Aldinga
item.description: Three cult South Australian wine labels have joined forces at Under the Sun Wine Collective, opening a shared Aldinga cellar door and bar.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Thursday February 5th and the days ahead
item.description: Here's the weather for February 5th and a look at what's to come over the weekend.

item.title: South Australia’s nurses and midwives offered biggest pay rise in 15 years
item.description: The State Government has proposed largest pay rise in 15 years for SA nurses and midwives, along with additional benefits aimed at improving job satisfaction and workforce conditions.
